This threshold operates well within the valid range (20-40 GeV) where Algorithm-L2 maintains >80% efficiency at the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate.

Algorithm-L2 at 37 GeV represents the best achievable performance given the constraints, being the only algorithm that satisfies all requirements while maximizing signal efficiency.
